full_judgment:
27. We have looked into Ext.10 closely. The letter Ext 10 a blue carbon copy of the original but designation of the addressee has been typed out in original. It has not been explained as to why the carbon copy of the letter should con lain the addressee's name in original typing. Mr. Saad Ahmed submits that the designation of the addressee was typed out subsequently and the very appearance of Ext. 10 is suggestive of interpolation. Loo king closely at Ext. 10 we have no manner of doubt that it is so. 

 28. Further it is also not understood why the writer Khelafat Hossain being Chairman of a village Peace Committee should address a letter to the Chairman of the District Peace Committee through the Sub-Divisional Adjutant of Razakars. He could have addressed the letter directly to the Chairman. Dist. Peace Committee, leaving it to him to arrange the despatch of Razakars to the designated villages. Or he could have written the letter directly to the Razakar authorities. The very form of address of this letter is suggestive of an interpolation.
